English: This study examines (1) the prevalence of current contraceptive use; and (2) the independent association between adolescent pregnancy and effective contraception use.

Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ṣe àyẹ̀wo (1) ìwọ́pọ̀ ìlo ọ̀gun adátọ̀lọ́wọ́; àti (2) òmìnira ìṣepọ̀ láàárín ìlóyún ọ̀dọ́ àti ìlo ògun adátọ̀lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luhlola (1) ukusabalala kokusetshenziswa kwamanje kokuvimbela inzalo; kanye (2) nenhlangano ezimele phakathi kokukhulelwa kwentsha kanye nokusetshenziswa ngendlela ephumelelayo kokuvimbela inzalo.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya yi nazarin (1) yawan amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa a halin yanzu; da (2) ƙungiya mai zaman kanta tsakanin matasa masu ciki da kuma amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa mai inganci.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di lekola (1) go tlala ga tšhomišo ya dithibelapelego; le (2) kamano ye e ikemego magareng ga boimana bja bafsa ba mahlalagading le tšhomišo ya dithibelapelego ye e šomago gabotse.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት (1) ወቅታዊ የወሊድ መከላከያ አጠቃቀም መስፋፋትን፤ እና (2) በጉርምስና ዕድሜ ላይ ባሉ ወጣቶች እርግዝና እና ውጤታማ የእርግዝና መከላከያ አጠቃቀም መካከል ያለውን ገለልተኛ ቁርኝት ይመረምራል።

English: This study uses baseline cross-sectional data from a youth-centered sexual and reproductive health (SRH) cohort study among youth (aged 16–24) in Soweto and Durban (2011–2017).
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kukozesa obubaka okuva mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa ku bavubuka ku nsonga y’okuzaala n’okwegatta (SRH) mu bavubuka (abali wakati w’emyaka 16-24) mu bitundu bya Soweto ne Durban (2011–2017).
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí lo ìjìnlẹ̀ dátà ìwádìí ìṣekiri tó rọ̀ mọ́ ìṣakọṣabo ọ̀dọ́ àti ọ̀wọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ ìlàna ipa ìbí láàárín àwọn ọ̀dọ́ (ọjọ́ orí 16-24) ní Soweto àti Durban (2011-2017).
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lusebenzisa idatha eyisisekelo ehlukene evela ocwaningweni lweqoqo olugxile kwentsha kwezocansi kanye nokuzala (SRH) entsheni (eneminyaka engu-16–24) eSoweto naseThekwini ( 2011–2017).
Hausa: Wannan binciken yana amfani da bayanan sashe na asali daga nazarin ƙungiyar jima’i da lafiyar haihuwa (SRH) a tsakanin matasa (shekaru 16 zuwa24) a cikin Soweto da kumaDurban (2011–2017).
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di šomiša tshedimošo ya makala a mantši go tšwa go dinyakišišo tša dihlopha tša bafsa tša mabapi le maphelo a thobalano le pelego ya bafsa (SRH) gareng ga bafsa (ba mengwaga ye 16–24) ka Soweto le ka Durban (2011–2017).
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በወጣቶች-ተኮር የወሲብ እና የስነ-ተዋልዶ ጤና (SRH) በሶዌቶ እና ደርባን (2011-2017) በወጣቶች መካከል (ከ16-24 እድሜ ያለው) የቡድን ጥናት ሁለገብ መረጃን ይጠቀማል።

English: Among 207/253 females reporting consensual sexual activity, crude and adjusted logistic regression examine associations between ever having an adolescent pregnancy (aged 15–19) or pregnancy at age 20–24 (ref no pregnancy) and effective contraception use (barrier and/or hormonal methods) in the last 6 months.
Luganda: Mu bakyala 207/253 abeegatta nga beeyagalidde, omutetenkanyirizo gw’ebivuddemu gwekaliriza enkolagana wakati w’okuba nga baali bafunye ku lubuto olw’ekivubuka (nga bali wakati w’emyaka 15-19) oba okufuna olubuto ku myaka 20-24 n’enkozesa ennungi ey’enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto (enkola eziziyiza ne/oba enkola ez’enkwaso) mu myezi 6 egiyise.
Yoruba: Láàárín obìnrin 207/253 tó ń ṣe ìfisùn ìbálòpọ̀ àfọwọ́sí, ìkàńpá àti ìtúnṣe àwòṣe oníṣirò ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìbáṣepọ̀ láàárín nínú oyún lọ́dọ̀ọ́ (ọmọ ọdún 15-19) tàbí oyún ní ọmọ ọdún 20-24 (àìtọ́ka oyún) àti ìlo ògun adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ (ìdènà àti/tàbí ìlànà hòmọ́nù) ní oṣù 6 sẹ́yìn.
Zulu: Phakathi kwabesifazane abangu-207/253 ababika isenzo socansi esivumelanayo, ukuhlehla okungalungile nokulungisiwe kuhlola ukuhlangana phakathi kokukhulelwa kwentsha (abaneminyaka engu-15-19) noma ukukhulelwa eneminyaka engu-20-24 (i-ref nokukhulelwa) kanye nokusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kokuvimbela inzalo (umgoqo kanye/noma izindlela zamahomoni) ezinyangeni ezingu-6 ezedlule.
Hausa: Daga cikin mata guda 207/253 da suke bayar da rahoton ayyukan jima’i da aka yarda da su, ɗanyen aiki da kuma daidaita yanayin koma bayan tattalin arziƙi suna nazarin ƙungiyoyi tsakanin taɓa samun ciki na samari (shekaru 15–19) ko ciki a cikin shekaru 20–24 (babu ciki) da ingantaccen amfani da hana haifuwa (shamaki da/ko Hanyoyin canza sinadaran haihuwa) a cikin watanni 6 na ƙarshe.
Northern Sotho: Gareng ga basadi ba 207/253 bao ba bagago gore ba tsenela thobalano ya tumelelano, tshekatshekokakanyo le yeo e beakantšwego di lekola kamano magareng ga go ima ga bafsa ba mahlalagading (ba mengwaga ye 15–19) goba boimana ka mengwaga ye 20–24 (tšhupetšo ya palo ya baimana) le tšhomišo ya dithibelapelego ye e šomago gabotse (ya lepheko le/goba mekgwa ya dihomoune) mo dikgweding tše di fetilego tše 6.
Amharic: ስምምነት ያለው የወሲብ እንቅስቃሴን ሪፖርት ካደረጉት ከ207/253 ሴቶች መካከል፣ ጥሬ እና የተስተካከለ የአቅርቦት አማካይ ተዛምዶ በጉርምስና ዕድሜ ላይ ያለ እርግዝና (ከ15-19 ዕድሜ) ወይም በ20-24 ዓመት እርግዝና (እርግዝና የሌለበት) እና ውጤታማ የእርግዝና መከላከያ አጠቃቀም (እንቅፋት እና/ወይም የሆርሞን ዘዴዎች) መካከል ባለፉት 6 ወራት ውስጥ ያለውን ግንኙነት ይመረምራል።

English: Over one-third (34.3%, n = 71) of females reported a history of adolescent pregnancy and 13.0% (n = 27) had a pregnancy at age 20–24.
Luganda: Abakyala abasoba mu kitundu kimu kyakusatu (34.3%, n = 71) baalaga nga balina ebyafaayo by’olubuto lw’ekivubuka n’abawala abakola ebitundu 13.0% (n = 27) baafuna olubuto ku myaka 20–24.
Yoruba: Jú ìdá kan nínú mẹ́ta (34.3%, n = 71) àwọn obìnrin ni wọ́n ṣe àkọ́lẹ̀ ìtàn otún ọ̀dọ́ àti 13.0% (n = 27) ni oyún ni ọmọ ọdún 20 - 24.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwengxenye eyodwa kwezintathu (34.3%, n = 71) yabesifazane ibike umlando wokukhulelwa kwentsha kanti u-13.0% (n = 27) ube nokukhulelwa eneminyaka engu-20–24.
Hausa: Sama da kashi ɗaya bisa uku (34.3%, n = 71) na mata sun ruwaito tarihin ciki na samari da 13.0% (n = 27) yana da ciki a shekaru 20-24.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ya go feta tee-tharong (34.3%, n = 71) ya basadi ba begile gore ba imile ba sa le bafsa ba mahlalagading gomme 13.0% (n = 27) ba imile ge ba na le mengwaga ye 20–24.
Amharic: ከአንድ ሶስተኛ በላይ (34.3%፣ n = 71) ሴቶች በጉርምስና ዕድሜ ላይ ያለ የእርግዝና ታሪክን ሪፖርት አድርገዋል እና 13.0% (n = 27) ከ20-24 ዓመታቸው እርግዝና ነበራቸው።

English: Nearly all (95.9%, n = 94) first pregnancies were unintentional.
Luganda: Kyenkana embuto zonna ezisooka (95.9%, n = 94) tezaali neetegekere.
Yoruba: Bí i gbogbo (95.9%, n = 94) oyún àkọ́kọ́ kì í jẹ́ ìmọ̀ọ́mọ̀ ṣe.
Zulu: Cishe bonke (95.9%, n = 94) ukukhulelwa kokuqala bekungahlosiwe.
Hausa: Kusan duka (95.9%, n = 94) ɗaukar ciki na farko sun kasance ba da gangan ba.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ye e nyakilego goba ka moka (95.9%, n = 94) boimana bja mathomo bo bile bjo e sego bja maikemišetšo.
Amharic: ሁሉም ማለት ይቻላል (95.9%፣ n = 94) የመጀመሪያ እርግዝናዎች ሳይታሰብባቸው ነበሩ።

English: Current effective contraceptive use was reported by 74.6% (n = 53) with an adolescent pregnancy, 66.6% (n = 18) of those pregnant at 20–24 years, and 46.8% (n = 51) of never pregnant females (p < 0.001).
Luganda: Enkozesa y’enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto entuukamu mu kiseera ekyo zaakozesebwa abantu abakola ebitundu 74.6% (n = 53) abaafuna olubuto lw’ekivubuka, ng’ebitundu 66.6% (n = 18) ku abo olubuto baalufunira wakati w’emyaka 20–24, n’ebitundu 46.8% (n = 51) eby’abakyala abatafunangako lubuto (p < 0.001).
Yoruba: Àwọn ògun adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ ìsìnyí jẹ́ èyí tí a fi sùn pẹ̀lú 74.6% (n = 53) oyún ọ̀dọ́,  66.6% (n = 18) àwọn oyún yẹ́n ní ọmọ ọdún 20-24, àti 46.8% (n = 51) àwọn obìnrin tí ò lóyún rí (p < 0.001).
Zulu: Ukusetshenziswa kwamanje kokuvimbela inzalo okusebenzayo kubikwe ngamaphesenti angama-74.6 (n = 53) ngokukhulelwa kwentsha, u-66.6% (n = 18) walabo abakhulelwe abaneminyaka engama-20-24, kanye nama-46.8% (n = 51) kwabesifazane abangakaze bakhulelwe (p 0.001).
Hausa: An bayar da rahoton amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa mai inganci na yanzu ta hanyar 74.6% (n = 53) tare da ciki na matasa, 66.6% (n = 18) na masu ciki a cikin shekaru 20 zuwa 24, da 46.8% (n = 51) na mata waɗanda ba su taɓa ɗaukar ciki ba (p < 0.001).
Northern Sotho: Tšhomišo ya bjale ye kaone ya dithibelapelego e begilwe ka 74.6% (n = 53) fao go bilego le boima bja bafsa ba mahlalagading, 66.6% (n = 18) bja bao ba imilego ba na le mengwaga ye 20–24, le 46.8% (n = 51) go basadi bao ba sego ba ka ba ima (p < 0.001).
Amharic: አሁን ያለው ውጤታማ የእርግዝና መከላከያ አጠቃቀም በ74.6% (n = 53) በጉርምስና ጊዜ እርግዝና፣ 66.6% (n = 18) በ20-24 አመት እርጉዝ ከሆኑ፣ እና 46.8% (n = 51) ፈፅሞ እርጉዝ ካልሆኑ ሴቶች (p <0.001) ሪፖርት ተደርጓል።

English: All effective contraceptive users pregnant at 20–24 years and 83% (n = 44) of the adolescent pregnancy group reported using hormonal methods vs. 52.9% (n = 27) of never pregnant females.
Luganda: Bonna abakozesa obulungi enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto, abaafuna olubuto wakati w’emyaka 20-24 n’ebitundu 83% (n = 44) eby’ekibinja ekirimu abaafuna olubuto lw’ekivubuka baagamba nti baakozesa enkola z’enkwaso bw’ogeraageranya n’ebitundu 52.9% (n = 27) eby’abakyala abatafunangako lubuto.
Yoruba: Gbogbo alo ògun adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ tó lóyún ní ọmọ ọdún 20-24 àti 83% (n = 44) ọ̀wọ́ ọ̀dọ́ tó lóyún ṣe ìfisùn lílo ìlàna hòmóònù vs.  52.9% (n = 27) àwọn obìnrin tí ò lóyún rí.
Zulu: Bonke abasebenzisi bokuvimbela inzalo abaphumelelayo abakhulelwe abaneminyaka engu-20-24 kanye nama-83% (n = 44) weqembu lokukhulelwa kwentsha babike basebenzisa izindlela zamahomoni uma kuqhathaniswa no-52.9% (n = 27) wabesifazane abangakaze bakhulelwe.
Hausa: Duk masu amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa masu inganci da suka ɗauki ciki a cikin shekaru 20 zuwa 24 da kuma kashi 83% (n = 44) na rukunin masu ciki matasa sun ruwaito yin amfani da hanyoyin canza sinadaran haihuwa da kuma 52.9% (n = 27) na mata da su taɓa ɗaukar ciki ba.
Northern Sotho: Bašomiši ka moka ba dithibelapelego tše di šomago gabotse bao ba imilego ka mengwaga ye 20–24 gomme 83% (n = 44) ya sehlopha sa bao ba imilego ka nakong ya mengwaga ya mahlalagading ba begile gore ba be ba šomiša mokgwa wa thibelapelego ya dihomoune ge go bapetšwa le 52.9% (n = 27) ya basadi bao ba sego ba ka ba ima.

English: Researchers are calling for better sex education in South Africa to prevent unwanted teen pregnancies, which were still 1 of the top 10 risk factors for death in this age group in 2015.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bakubiriza wabeerewo okusomesa abantu ku nsonga z’okwegatta okusingako mu ggwanga lya South Africa okusobola okuziyiza embuto z’ekivubuka eziteetegekeddwa, ezaali zikyali 1 ku butyabaga 10 obuviirako okufa kw’abantu abagwa mu ttuluba lino mu 2015.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí ń pè fún ẹ̀kọ́ ìbálòpò ní South Africa láti ṣe ìdíwọ́ oyún àìfẹ́ láàárín àwọn ọ̀dọ́, tó jẹ́ 1 nínú 10 àwọn ìṣokùnfa ikú láàárín ọ̀wọ́ ọjọ́ orí wọn ní 2015.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bafuna imfundo engcono yezocansi eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuvinjwe ukukhulelwa kwentsha okungafunwa, obekwesi-1 kwezingu-10 ezibeka engcupheni yokushona kuleli qembu leminyaka yobudala ngo-2015.
Hausa: Masu bincike suna kira da a inganta ilimin jima’i a ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu domin hana ciki wanda ba a so a tsakanin matasa, wanda har yanzu shi ne na 1 daga cikin manyan abubuwan haɗari guda 10 da suke haifar da mutuwa a cikin wannan rukunin shekaru a cikin shekarar 2015.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ipiletša gore go be le thuto ye kaone ya tša thobalano go thibela boimana bja bafsa bja go se nyakege, bjo e lego ye 1 ya bjo bongwe bja dikotsi tša godimo go tše 10 tše di bakago mahu ka mo sehlopheng se sa mengwaga ka 2015.

English: They studied women between the ages of 15 and 24, and found that many only learnt about contraception, or pregnancy prevention, from their healthcare team after an unintended pregnancy.
Luganda: Beekaliriza abakyala abali wakati w’emyaka 15 ne 24, ne bazuula nga abasinga ku bo bategeera ebikwata ku nkola z’okuziyiza okufuna embuto, okuva mu basawo baabwe oluvannyuma lw’okufuna olubuto lwe bateeyagalidde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí àwọn obìnrin láàárín ọjọ́ orí 15 àti 24, wọ́n ri pé ọ̀pọ̀ mọ̀ nípa ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́, tàbí adènà oyún, látọdọ̀ àwọn oníṣe ìlera wọn lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n lóyún tán.
Zulu: Bacwaninga abesifazane abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-24, bathola ukuthi abaningi bafunda kuphela ngokuvimbela inzalo, noma ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa, ethimbeni labo lezempilo ngemva kokukhulelwa okungahlosiwe.

Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba dira dinyakišišo ka ga basadi ba mengwaga ya magareng ga ye 15 le ye 24, gomme ba hwetša gore ba bantši ba tsebile fela ka ga dithibelapelego, ka ga go thobela boimana, go tšwa go sehlopha sa bona sa tlhokomelo ya maphelo ka morago ga ge ba imile ka ntle le maikemišetšo.

English: In the adjusted model, a history of adolescent pregnancy was associated with 3.45 (95%CI = 1.75–6.82) times greater odds of effective contraceptive use (vs. no pregnancy).
Luganda: Mu mutetenkanyirizo ogukyusiddwamu, ebyafaayo by’olubuto lw’ekivubuka byali byekuusa n’emirundi 3.45 (95%CI = 1.75–6.82) egy’okukozesa obulungi enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto (bw’ogeraageranya n’obutafuna lubuto).

Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu era baayagala okulaba oba ng’okufuna olubuto ku myaka emito kikosa omukisa gw’okuba ng’omukyala oyo ajja kukozesa enkola eziyiza okufuna embuto okusobola okwewala okufuna olubuto mu biseera eby’omu maaso.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún fẹ́ ri bí lílóyún ní ọmọdé ń kópa bóyá obìnrin máa lo ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ láti dènà oyún níní lọ́jọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Baphinde bafuna ukubona ukuthi ukukhulelwa esemncane kuyaliphazamisa yini ithuba lokuthi owesifazane asebenzise isivimbeli ukuze avikele ukukhulelwa esikhathini esizayo.
Hausa: Sun kuma so su ga ko yin ciki a ƙuruciya yana shafar damar da mace za ta yi amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa don hana juna biyu a nan gaba.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba be ba nyaka go bona ge eba go ima o sa le yo monnyane go ama sebaka sa gore mosadi a ka šomiša dithibelapelego go thibela boimana ka moso.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በወጣት ዕድሜ ላይ መፀነስ አንዲት ሴት ለወደፊቱ እርግዝናን ለመከላከል የእርግዝና መከላከያን እንድትጠቀም የማድረግ እድል ላይ ተጸዕኖ እንደሚያሳድር ለማየት ፈልገዋል።

English: The researchers analysed the existing 2014 to 2017 AYAZAZI sexual and reproductive health study data.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beekaliriza obubaka obwaliwo obwa AYAZAZI obwafuunibwa okuva mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa ku nsonga y’okuzaala n’okwegatta, obwakuŋŋaanyizibwa wakati wa 2014 ne 2017.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà yànàná dátà AYAZAZI ọdún 2014 sí 2017 lórí i èto ìbálòpọ̀ àti ìlera ìbí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bahlaziye idatha ekhona yocwaningo lwezocansi nokuzala lwe-AYAZAZI lwango-2014 kuya ku-2017.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi nazarin wanzazzun bayanan nazarin lafiyar jima’i da haihuwa AYAZAZI na shekarar 2014 zuwa shekarar 2017.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba sekasekile tshedimošo ya dinyakišišo tša bjale tša AYAZAZI ka ga maphelo a tša thobalano le a pelego tša go tloga ka 2014 go fihla ka 2017.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከ2014 እስከ 2017 ያለውን የAYAZAZI ወሲባዊ እና የስነ ተዋልዶ ጤና ጥናት መረጃን ተንትነዋል።

English: It included 207 women aged 16 to 24 from Durban or Soweto, South Africa.
Luganda: Kwalimu abakyala 207 abali wakati w’emyaka 16 ne 24 okuva mu kitundu kya Durban oba ekya Soweto, ebisangibwa mu ggwanga lya South Africa.
Yoruba: Ó ní àwọn obìnrin 207 tí ọjọ́ orí wọn tó 16 sí 24 láti Durban tàbí Soweto, South Africa.
Zulu: Bekuhlanganisa nabesifazane abangu-207 abaneminyaka engu-16 kuya ku-24 abasuka eThekwini noma eSoweto, eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Ya haɗa da mata guda 207 masu shekaru 16 zuwa 24 daga Durban ko Soweto, Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Yona e akareditše basadi ba 207 ba mengwaga ye 16 go fihla go ye 24 go tšwa ka Durban goba Soweto, ka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: ከ16 እስከ 24 ዓመት የሆናቸው 207 ሴቶችን ከደርባን ወይም ሶዌቶ፣ ደቡብ አፍሪካ አካቷል።

English: The data included information about their sexual behaviour, contraceptive use, and any previous pregnancies.
Luganda: Obubaka bwalimu obubaka obukwata ku bulamu bwabwe obw’okwegatta, enkozesa y’enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto, awamu n’embuto zonna ze baali bafunyeeko mu biseera eby’emabega.
Yoruba: Dátà náà ní ìròyìn nípa ìhùwa ìbálòpọ̀, ìlo ògun idátọ̀lọ́wọ́, àti ìlóyún àtẹ̀yìnwá.
Zulu: Ulwazi lwaluhlanganisa imininingwane mayelana nokuziphatha kwabo kwezocansi, ukusetshenziswa kokuvimbela inzalo, nanoma yikuphi ukukhulelwa kwangaphambilini.
Hausa: Bayanan sun haɗa da bayanai game da halayensu na jima’i, amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa, da duk wani ciki na baya.
Northern Sotho: Tshedimošo e akareditše maitshwaro a bona a tša thobalano, tšhomišo ya dithibelapelego, le boimana bofe goba bofe bjo bo fetilego.
Amharic: መረጃው ስለ ወሲባዊ ባህሪያቸው፣ ስለ የእርግዝና መከላከያ አጠቃቀማቸው፣ እና ስለማንኛውም የቀድሞ እርግዝናዎቻቸው መረጃን አካቷል።

English: Nearly half of the women (47%) had been pregnant before age 25, and almost all of the pregnancies (96%) were unintentional.
Luganda: Kyenkana ekitundutundu ky’abakyala abo (47%) baali baafuna embuto nga tebannaweza myaka 25, ate era nga kyenkana embuto zonna (96%) tezaali neetegekere.
Yoruba: Ó tọ́ ìdajì àwọn obìnrin (47%) lón ti lóyún kọ́ tó pé ọmọ ọdún 25, àti pé gbogbo oyún níní náà (96%) kì í ṣe èyí tí wọ́n fẹ́ ní.
Zulu: Cishe ingxenye yabesifazane (47%) yayikhulelwe ingakafiki iminyaka engu-25, futhi cishe bonke ukukhulelwa (96%) kwakungahlosile.
Hausa: Kusan rabin mata (47%) sun kasance masu ciki kafin shekaru 25, kuma kusan dukkanin masu ciki (96%) sun kasance ba da gangan ba.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ya go nyaka go fihla go seripagare sa basadi (47%) ba ile ba ima pele ga ge ba fihla go mengwaga ye 25, gomme palo ya go nyaka go ba boimana ka moka (96%) e be e le bjo e sego bja maikemišetšo.
Amharic: ከሴቶቹ ውስጥ ግማሽ የሚጠጉት (47%) ከ25 ዓመታቸው በፊት እርጉዝ ነበሩ፣ እና ሁሉም ማለት ይቻላል (96%) እርግዝናዎች ሳይታሰቡ ነበሩ።

English: About 75% of women who had been pregnant when they were between ages 15 and 19 used contraceptives at the time of the study.
Luganda: Abakyala abakola ebitundu nga 75% abaafuna embuto nga bali wakati w’emyaka 15 ne 19 baali bakozesa enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto mu kiseera okunoonyereza we kwakolebwa.
Yoruba: Bí i 75% àwọn obìnrin tọ́ ti lóyún nígbà tọ́ wà bí i ọmọ ọdún 15 sí 19 lo ògun ìdátọ̀lọ́wọ́ nígbà ìwádìí yìí.
Zulu: Cishe u-75% wabesifazane ababekhulelwe ngesikhathi beneminyaka ephakathi kuka-15 no-19 basebenzisa izinto zokuvimbela inzalo ngesikhathi socwaningo.
Hausa: Kimanin kashi 75% na matan da suke da juna biyu lokacin da suke tsakanin shekaru 15 zuwa 19 sun yi amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa a lokacin binciken.
Northern Sotho: Palo ye e ka bago 75% ya basadi bao ba bego ba imile ge ba be ba na le mengwaga ya magareng ga ye 15 le ye 19 ba šomišitve dithibelapelego ka nakong ya dinyakišišo.
Amharic: ከ15 እስከ 19 ዓመታት ባለው የዕድሜ ክልል ውስጥ እርጉዝ ከነበሩት ሴቶች መካከል 75% ያህሉ በጥናቱ ወቅት የእርግዝና መከላከያዎችን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: On the other hand, only 67% of those who became pregnant between ages 20 and 24, and 47% of women who had never been pregnant, used contraceptives.
Luganda: Ku ludda olulala, abakyala abakola ebitundu 67% ku abo abaafuna embuto nga bali wakati w’emyaka 20 ne 24, n’ebitundu 47% eby’abakyala abaali batafunangako mbuto, be baakozesa enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀nà míràn, 67% péré nínú àwọn tọ́ lóyún láàárín ọmọ ọdún 20 sí 24, àti 47% àwọn obìnrin tí ò lóyún rí, ń lo ògun ìdátọ̀lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, u-67% kuphela walabo abakhulelwa phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 no-24, kanye nama-47% abesifazane abangakaze bakhulelwe, abasebenzisa izinto zokuvimbela inzalo.
Hausa: A ɗaya ɓangaren, kashi 67% na waɗanda suka ɗauki juna biyu a tsakanin shekaru 20 zuwa 24, da kashi 47% na matan da ba su taɓa ɗaukar ciki ba, sun yi amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Ka go le lengwe, ke fela 67% ya bao ba ilego ba ima ba mengwaga ya magareng ga ye 20 le ye 24, le 47% ya basadi bao ba sego ba ka ba ima, bao ba ilego ba šomiša dithibelapelego.
Amharic: በሌላ በኩል፣ ከ20 እስከ 24 ዓመት ዕድሜዎች ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ ከፀነሱት መካከል 67%ው ብቻ፣ እና እርጉዝ ካልነበሩት ሴቶች 47%ው ብቻ የእርግዝና መከላከያዎችን ይጠቀሙ ነበር።

English: The researchers concluded that people who were pregnant as an adolescent had 3.5 times greater odds of using contraceptives afterwards.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baawunzika nga bagamba nti abantu abaafuna embuto nga bali mu myaka egy’ekivubuka baalina emikisa gya mirundi 3.5 egikozesa enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto oluvannyuma.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà pinu pé àwọn tọ́ lóyún lọ́dọ̀ọ́ yóò fẹ́ẹ̀ lo ògùn ìdátọ̀lọ́wọ́ bó bá yá ní bí i ìgba 3.5.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphethe ngokuthi abantu ababekhulelwe besebancane babe namathuba amakhulu okuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-3.5 okusebenzisa izinto zokuvimbela inzalo ngemva kwalokho.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kammala da cewa mutanen da suke da juna biyu a lokacin samartaka suna da ninki 3.5 na dama mafi girma na yin amfani da rigakafin hana haihuwa bayan haka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba phetha ka gore batho bao ba bego ba imile ge ba sa le bafsa ba mahlalagading ba bile le dibaka tša makga a go feta 3.5 a gore ba ka šomiša dithibelapelego ka morago ga fao.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በጉርምስና ዕድሜ ላይ እያሉ እርጉዝ የሆኑ ሰዎች የእርግዝና መከላከያዎችን የመጠቀም እድላቸው በ3.5 እጥፍ ይበልጣል ሲሉ ደምድመዋል።

English: These results suggest that people seek contraceptives only after an unintended pregnancy.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa bino biraga nti abantu banoonya enkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto nga bamaze kufuna lubuto lwe bateetegekedde.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì wọ̀nyí fihàn pé àwọn ènìyàn ń wá ògun ìdátọ̀lọ́wọ́ lẹ́yìn níní oyún tí wọn ò fẹ́.
Zulu: Le miphumela iphakamisa ukuthi abantu bafune izinto zokuvimbela inzalo kuphela ngemva kokukhulelwa okungahlosiwe.
Hausa: Waɗannan sakamakon sun nuna cewa mutane suna neman rigakafin hana haihuwa ne kawai bayan ciki wanda ba a yi niyya ba.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tše di šišinya gore batho ba nyaka dithibelapelego fela ka morago ga ge ba imile ka ntle le maikemišetšo.
Amharic: እነዚህ ውጤቶች እንደጠቆሙት ሰዎች የእርግዝና መከላከያዎችን የሚሹት ያልተፈለገ እርግዝና ካጋጠማቸው በኋላ ብቻ ነው።

English: More than half of the women in the study said that they learned about contraception from a nurse, doctor, or counsellor, and less than 10% learned about it from school.
Luganda: Abakyala abakola ettundutundu erisinga obunene mu kunoonyereza kuno baagamba nti obubaka obukwata ku nkola eziziyiza okufuna embuto baabufuna kuva eri mujjanjabi, musawo, omulyowi w’emyoyo, ate era ng’abakyala abataweza na bitundu 10% baabuyigira ku ssomero.
Yoruba: Ju ìdájọ lọ ni àwọn obìnrin inú ìwádìí yìí lọ́ sọ pé àwọ́n kọ́ nípa ògun ìdátọ̀lọ́wọ́ láti ọ̀dọ nọ́ọ̀sì, dókìtà, tàbí káúnsẹ́lọ̀, àti bíì ìdá tó kéré sí 10% lọ́ kọ́ nípa rẹ̀ ní ilé ìwé.
Zulu: Bangaphezu kwengxenye yabesifazane ocwaningweni bathi bafunde ngohlelo lokuvikela ukukhulelwa kumhlengikazi, udokotela noma umeluleki, kanti bangaphansi kuka-10% abafunde ngakho esikoleni.
Hausa: Fiye da rabin matan da suke cikin binciken sun ce sun sami masaniya ne game da rigakafin hana haihuwa daga ma’aikacin jinya ko likita ko mai bayar da shawara, kuma ƙasa da kashi 10% sun sami masaniya game da shi daga makaranta.
Northern Sotho: Palo ya go feta seripagare saBasadi ba ka dinyakišišong ba boletše gore ba ithutile ka ga dithibelapelego go mooki, ngaka, goba go moeletši, gomme palo ya ka fase ga 10% yona e ithutile ka tšona sekolong.
Amharic: በጥናቱ ውስጥ ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑት ሴቶች ስለ የእርግዝና መከላከያ ከነርስ ፣ ከዶክተር፣ ወይም ከአማካሪ እንደተማሩ ሲናገሩ እና ከ10% ያነሱት ከትምህርት ቤት እንደተማሩ ተናግረዋል።

English: This highlights a need for better early sexual education and youth-friendly sexual and reproductive health services.
Luganda: Kino kiraga obwetaavu bw’okusomesa amangu abantu ebikwata ku kwegatta awamu n’enkola z’okwegatta n’okuzaala ezituukana n’abavubuka.
Yoruba: Èyí fi ìní sí ẹ̀kọ́ nípa ìbálòpọ̀ àti ìlòpọ ọlọ́rẹ̀ẹ́-ajẹmọ́dọ̀ọ́ pẹ̀lú ẹ̀to ìbí hàn.
Zulu: Lokhu kugqamisa isidingo semfundo engcono kakhulu yezocansi kusenesikhathi kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo zocansi kanye nokuzala ezifanele intsha.
Hausa: Wannan yana nuna buƙatar ingantaccen ilimin jima’i da wuri da kuma ayyukan na lafiyar jima'i da haihuwa masu dacewa da matasa.
Northern Sotho: Se se hlagiša gore go na le tlhokego ya thuto ye kaone ya ka pela ya tša thobalano le ditirelo tša maphelo ka ga thobalano le pego tšeo di nago le segwera le bafsa.
Amharic: ይህ የተሻለ የቅድመ የወሲብ ትምህርት እና ለወጣቶች ተስማሚ የሆነ የወሲብ እና ስነ ተዋልዶ የጤና አገልግሎቶች አስፈላጊነትን ያሳያል።

English: The researchers said that these results might not apply to other places in South Africa, because many participants were from similar communities.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti bino ebyazuulibwa biyinza obutatuukira ku bitundu birala ebisangibwa mu ggwanga lya South Africa, kubanga abeetabi abasinga obungi baali bava mu bitundu ebifaanagana.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn èsì wọ̀nyí lè má bá àwọn ibòmíràn mu ní South Africa, nítorí ọ̀pọ àwọn olùkópa wá láti agbègbè kan náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi le miphumela ingase ingasebenzi kwezinye izindawo eNingizimu Afrika, ngoba ababambiqhaza abaningi bavela emiphakathini efanayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce wannan sakamakon ba zai shafi wasu wurare a Afirka ta Kudu ba, saboda yawancin waɗanda suka shiga binciken sun fito ne daga al’ummomi iri ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipoelo tše di ka no se šome mafelong a mangwe ka Afrika Borwa, ka gobane bakgathatema ba bantši ba be ba etšwa ditšhabeng tše di swanago.
Amharic: ብዙዎቹ ተሳታፊዎች ከተመሳሳይ ማህበረሰቦች ስለነበሩ፣ እነዚህ ውጤቶች በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ባሉ ሌሎች ቦታዎች ላይ ላይሠሩ ይችላሉ ብለዋል ተመራማሪዎቹ።

English: But, they mention that these results are similar to other studies done in South Africa.
Luganda: Naye, bagamba nti bino bye baazuula bifanagana n’ebyo ebiri mu kunoonyereza okulala okukoleddwa mu ggwanga lya South Africa.
Yoruba: Àmọ́, wọ́n mẹ́nubàá pé èsì yìí fara pẹ́ irúfẹ́ àwọn ìwádìí tọ́ ti ṣe tẹ́lẹ̀ ní South Africa.
Zulu: Kodwa, babalula ukuthi le miphumela iyafana nezinye izifundo ezenziwa eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Amma, sun ambaci cewa waɗannan sakamakon sun yi kama da sauran nazarin da aka gudanar a Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Eupša, ba ile ba bolela gore dipoelo tše di swana le tša dinyakišišo tše dingwe tšeo di dirilwego ka Afrika Borwa.
